name: Ulster County, NY
findings: Ulster County has 627 nonprofit organizations. 299 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 253 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Ulster County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 33 arts and cultural organizations here list membership, compared with about 11 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Ulster County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 34 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
